items.title: Solana adds $378M in tokenized T-bills – Is Ethereum losing ground?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The addition of $378M in tokenized T-bills enhances Solana's liquidity and could attract institutional interest, potentially impacting its competitive position against Ethereum.
